description: Ships context receipts (retrievals, items, exclusions, and outcome/evidence/output events) from the local SQLite ContextReceiptStore into BigQuery tables. Incremental with cursors stored in BigQuery, idempotent on replay, so receipts can be joined with warehouse data and item feedback computed in SQL.

store_resource_key.label: Store Resource Key
store_resource_key.description: Resource key of the registered ContextReceiptStoreComponent resource (an object with read_since and get_receipt).

bigquery_resource_key.label: BigQuery Resource Key
bigquery_resource_key.description: Resource key of a dagster_gcp BigQueryResource (used as `with resource.get_client() as client`).

dataset.label: Dataset
dataset.description: Destination dataset, `project.dataset` (or just `dataset` to use the BigQuery client's default project). The five receipt tables and `context_sync_state` live here.

table_prefix.label: Table Prefix
table_prefix.description: Optional prefix for every table name in the dataset (e.g. 'prod_').

sync_name.label: Sync Name
sync_name.description: Name of this sync in `context_sync_state`; use different names if several stores ship into one dataset's state table (they should use different table_prefix values).

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Receipts / outcomes read from the store per batch.

max_batches.label: Max Batches
max_batches.description: Maximum batches per run; the next run continues from the stored cursor.

reconcile_recent_receipts.label: Reconcile Recent Receipts (deprecated)
reconcile_recent_receipts.description: Deprecated, ignored (kept so existing configs still load). Late evidence/output events are now shipped by the event cursor, so no reconcile window is needed.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (default: bigquery).

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

cron_schedule.label: Cron Schedule
cron_schedule.description: Optional cron expression; when set, a schedule runs this sync (e.g. '*/10 * * * *').

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).

retry_max_attempts.label: Retry Max Attempts
retry_max_attempts.description: Tries per BigQuery statement/load job on transient errors (ServiceUnavailable, InternalServerError, TooManyRequests, BadGateway, DeadlineExceeded, 403 rateLimitExceeded/quotaExceeded), with exponential backoff and full jitter. 1 disables retrying. The final failure raises the original error.

retry_max_backoff_seconds.label: Retry Max Backoff Seconds
retry_max_backoff_seconds.description: Upper bound on any single wait between retries.
